desc.zh: 从重复递归推导前缀状态，逐格解释独立星号的两种选择与滚动行。
desc.en: Derive prefix states from repeated recursion, then trace standalone stars and rolling rows.

concepts.name: Repeated prefix pairs
concepts.description: Follow two recursive paths to the same empty-text and b-star call.

concepts.name: Standalone wildcard dependencies
concepts.description: Derive empty consumption from left and one more character from above.

concepts.name: Rolling rows
concepts.description: Map prefix dependencies to two live rows in the Python solution.
